_readme: Marks specific assets/ or scripts/ path mentions that lint_skills.py's ASSETS_SCRIPTS_MENTION_RE check would otherwise flag as WARNING because the path doesn't exist inside that skill's own directory. Keyed by skill directory name; each entry is {"path": "<exact string as it appears in the skill's text>", "reason": "<why this specific mention is expected, not a broken reference>"}. A reason is required per entry — lint_skills.py warns on any entry missing one. Remove an entry once the path it covers is no longer mentioned anywhere in that skill — lint_skills.py flags stale entries automatically.

signatry-docx-brand.reason: This is not an orphaned script - it is a reference to the signatry-icons skill's icon-search script. SKILL.md names signatry-icons as a dependency ("Search with that skill's scripts/find_icons.py") — the script lives in that skill's directory, not this one.

This is not an orphaned script - it is a reference to the signatry-photo-library skill's photo-search script. SKILL.md names signatry-photo-library as a dependency ("the 44-image catalog and scripts/find_photos.py") — the script lives in that skill's directory, not this one.

signatry-pptx-brand.reason: This is not an orphaned script - it is a reference to script in a supporting skill within this bullet: signatry-photo-library's photo-search script, named as a dependency ("the 44-image catalog and scripts/find_photos.py") and referenced again in the Reference template files section and in references/design-system.md's photo-treatment guidance.

That path is intentionally a working-directory reference (post-cp, which flattens the file into ./assets/), not the skill's bundled path (assets/logos/quill_tab_legacy.png), so it's a false positive, not a real broken link - consistent with the reverted state confirmed self-consistent on 2026-07-31. The bundled asset itself lives at skills/signatry-pptx-brand/assets/logos/quill_tab_legacy.png and is used correctly elsewhere (e.g. the Logo and mark table).
